# Product Marketing Context

*Last updated: 2026-05-09*

## Product Overview
**One-liner:** Marketing-grade App Store screenshots, without the subscription.
**What it does:** Indie iOS developers drop in three raw mobile screenshots, name their app and category, and ShotStudio returns three polished App Store shots (1290×2796, iPhone 6.7" portrait spec) generated by gpt-image-2 — one polished version per uploaded source screen. Each set takes ~1 minute. The headline copy is AI-written from the user's pitch and target audience.
**Product category:** App Store screenshot generator / mobile app marketing asset tool.
**Product type:** Self-serve web app (Next.js, Clerk auth, Stripe checkout). Single-tenant, no team accounts.
**Business model:** One-time credit packs. No subscription, no trial, no upsell. Credits never expire. Money is never refunded; credits are refunded automatically only when image generation fails after our retry/fallback path is exhausted.
- Starter — $7 / 2 sets
- Growth — $17 / 5 sets (featured)
- Studio — $37 / 12 sets
- Each set = 3 polished images (one per user-uploaded source screen).
- Margins at $0.265/image OpenRouter cost: Starter ~70%, Growth ~71%, Studio ~70%.

## Target Audience
**Target companies:** Solo iOS developers, indie hackers, two-person studios, freelancers shipping client apps. Not enterprise.
**Decision-makers:** The developer is also the buyer. No procurement, no design team, no marketing manager.
**Primary use case:** Ship App Store Connect-ready screenshots in one sitting, the night before submission, without hiring a designer or learning Figma templates.
**Jobs to be done:**
- Turn raw simulator screenshots into screenshots that *look like a real launched app* — fast.
- A/B test alternate hero angles or copy without paying a designer per round.
- Get the right size/spec on the first try (1290×2796, sRGB, no transparency).
**Use cases:**
- First-time submitter prepping for App Store review.
- Existing app refreshing screenshots after a feature launch or rebrand.
- Indie running A/B tests on hero shot copy via App Store Connect experiments.
- Freelancer delivering client assets without doing the design work.

## Personas
B2C — single persona (the indie developer). Skipping the multi-stakeholder table.

## Problems & Pain Points
**Core problem:** Indies ship great apps with terrible screenshots. The actual asset work — Figma templates, mockup files, copywriting, exporting at the right spec — eats a weekend and looks amateur anyway.
**Why alternatives fall short:**
- Subscription tools (Screenshots.pro, AppMockUp, Previewed) charge $15–$40/mo for a one-time job. You forget to cancel.
- Figma templates require manual design work and look like a Figma template.
- Hiring a designer on Fiverr costs $50–$200 and takes days.
- Generic AI image tools don't know App Store specs and produce off-spec output.
**What it costs them:** A weekend of design work, a recurring subscription they'll forget to cancel, or worse — submitting with screenshots that hurt conversion on the listing.
**Emotional tension:** "I built the whole app myself. I shouldn't be stuck the night before submission because I can't make a few screenshots."

## Competitive Landscape
**Direct:** Screenshots.pro, AppMockUp, Previewed, Rotato, Shotbot — fall short because they're subscription-priced for a job most indies do once or twice a year, and most still require manual layout work.
**Secondary:** Figma + community templates — falls short because it's hours of fiddling with masks and exporting, and the result still looks like a template.
**Indirect:** Hiring a designer on Fiverr/Upwork — falls short because turnaround is days, cost is $50–$200, and revisions add another round-trip.
**Indirect:** Raw simulator screenshots with no polish — falls short because plain screenshots demonstrably hurt App Store conversion vs. marketing-style sets.

## Differentiation
**Key differentiators:**
- One-time pay. $7 minimum entry, $37 for 12 sets. No subscription anywhere on the site.
- Privacy-first by design: zero image persistence — uploads and outputs are never written to disk or storage. (Hard architectural commitment, not a marketing claim.)
- Opinionated output: 4-shot template, 4 style presets, AI-picked from category. No 5-page style wizard.
- Failed generations refund credits automatically — no support ticket.
- AI-written headline from the user's pitch + audience — they don't have to write copywriting.
**How we do it differently:** We pre-decided the 4-shot template, the 4 presets, and the spec. The user gives us 3 screenshots, an app name, a one-sentence pitch, and a category. We do the rest.
**Why that's better:** A weekend of work collapses to a minute. Cost collapses from $15–$40/mo (subscription) or $50–$200 (designer) to $7 once.
**Why customers choose us:** They want to ship tonight, not learn Figma. They resent subscriptions for one-shot jobs. They care about privacy.

## Objections
| Objection | Response |
|-----------|----------|
| "AI-generated screenshots will look generic / off-brand." | Four curated style presets bundle palette/type/backdrop/voice; per-shot regenerate is free; text on the preview is click-to-edit. |
| "What if the generation is bad?" | Failed generations auto-refund credits. Per-shot regenerate is free until you're happy. |
| "Why not just use a Figma template?" | Templates take hours and still look like templates. ShotStudio is one minute and AI-styled. |
| "Where do my uploads go?" | Nowhere. Uploads pass through memory to the model and are dropped. No images table, no S3, no thumbnail cache. |
| "Is this a subscription?" | No. One-time credit packs. Credits never expire. |

**Anti-persona:** Large brands, agencies, design teams who need pixel-precise control, brand guidelines compliance, custom illustration, or non-iPhone-6.7" outputs. Android-only developers (no Google Play export in v1). Anyone wanting team accounts or persistent generation history.

## Switching Dynamics
**Push:** Submission deadline tomorrow. Subscription renewed for a tool they used once. Designer turnaround is too slow. Figma weekend lost.
**Pull:** $7 entry. One minute. Looks like a real launched app. No subscription.
**Habit:** They've been using Figma + community templates, or paying a monthly subscription tool out of inertia.
**Anxiety:** Will the AI output look generic? Will it match the App Store spec on the first try? Will it leak my unreleased screenshots?

## Customer Language
**How they describe the problem:**
- "I just need screenshots for the App Store."
- "I don't want to pay a subscription for something I'll use once."
- "I'm not a designer."
- "I'm submitting tomorrow."
**How they describe us:**
- "Polished App Store screenshots in a minute."
- "One-time pay screenshot generator."
- "AI App Store screenshots."
**Words to use:** indie, ship, polished, marketing-grade, one-time pay, three shots, 1290×2796, App Store Connect, preset, never stored.
**Words to avoid:** "platform," "enterprise," "subscription," "AI-powered" (cliché — say *what* the AI does), "users" (call them indies/devs/makers), "synergy," "solution."
**Glossary:**
| Term | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| Set / generation set | One run = three output images, one polished shot per uploaded source screen. |
| Credit | One generation set. 1 credit = 1 set. |
| Preset | A bundled palette + type + backdrop + prompt voice. ShotStudio has four: soft_bright, dark_premium, clean_minimal, bold_playful. |
| Per-shot regenerate | Re-roll a single image in a set without consuming a new credit. |
| 1290×2796 | iPhone 6.7" portrait — the App Store Connect-required hero spec ShotStudio outputs. |

## Brand Voice
**Tone:** Confident, dry, declarative. Reads like a senior indie talking to a peer — not a marketer talking to a prospect.
**Style:** Short sentences. Specific numbers ($7, 1 minute, 1290×2796, three shots). Concrete claims, not adjectives. Light self-deprecation about the category ("The flow is opinionated on purpose.").
**Personality:** Opinionated, technical, anti-bloat, indie-friendly, privacy-respecting.

## Proof Points
**Metrics:** ~1 minute to three polished shots. $7 floor price. 4 presets. Zero image persistence (architectural).
**Customers:** None public yet (pre-launch / early traction).
**Testimonials:** None yet — capture once live; prioritize indie-on-Twitter/X quotes.
**Value themes:**
| Theme | Proof |
|-------|-------|
| One-time pay vs. subscription | $7 starter, credits never expire, no recurring charge anywhere on the site. |
| Speed to ship | Three inputs → three shots in ~1 minute. |
| Privacy by design | No images table, no object storage, in-memory pass-through. |
| Opinionated, not bloated | Pre-set 4-shot template, 4 presets, no 5-page style wizard. |
| No-regret pricing | Failed gens refund automatically; per-shot regenerate free. |

## Goals
**Business goal:** Indie iOS developer awareness → one-time credit-pack purchases. Volume comes from trial-by-purchase at $7, then upsell to Growth/Studio for repeat work.
**Conversion action:** Sign up → buy credits → generate. Sign-up is the primary CTA; pricing is the secondary.
**Current metrics:** Pre-launch / early — establish baseline at first traffic.
